editorial: Imagine the claustrophobia of a high-society gala colliding with the raw intensity of a cult uprising. You are thrust into a dizzying spiral where the vanity of Hollywood stardom is stripped away by a radical force that refuses to follow the script. Romain Gavras delivers a masterclass in tension, utilizing a frenetic visual style that makes the boundary between a staged performance and a fight for survival vanish. If you crave a satirical adrenaline rush that challenges your sense of morality while keeping you on the edge of your seat, this is your next obsession.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of dark satire and high-stakes hostage thrillers.
